Subject: Post-demo: Arcadia Health — compliance checklist & SOC 2 access

Hi Emily — thanks again for the demo time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move the compliance arm of procurement forward: 

What we covered
- Core integration surface and where PHI is hashed before transit
- Region/residency options (we currently offer us-east and eu-west)
- Typical latency and throughput targets for a 50 qps workload

Compliance asks you mentioned
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and any bridge/attestation letters
- Confirmation of GDPR/HIPAA scope for Arcadia's use case (data residency + processing)
- Vendor security questionnaire/DDQ to kick off (Procurement will coordinate)

Proposed owner handoffs
- I'll serve as project lead from Sales for coordination (me)
- Laura Bennett (cc) will handle evidence and the TrustSafe invitation
- Aditya Rao (cc) will be the technical SFTP/S3 contact if portal transfer isn't possible

Immediate next steps
1) Emily/procurement: share preferred delivery method for SOC 2 + bridge letter (TrustSafe portal access preferred, SFTP as fallback).
2) We will upload a temporary attestation (if helpful) and send a TrustSafe invite within 24 hours.
3) Procurement: please share the DDQ link or attach your vendor questionnaire — we can fill directly in DocuSign/HubSpot or provide spreadsheet.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (for internal architecture references).

If this looks correct, I'll get Laura to issue the TrustSafe invite and attach the temporary attestation while we gather the Type II file. Would a short follow-up on Friday work to confirm delivery?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Arcadia Health — compliance checklist & SOC 2 access

Hi Vivek — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from procurement/security side: 

1) SOC 2 Type II: we need the most recent 12-month coverage report plus any bridge letter that speaks to the gap to date if the report period doesn't include 2026 Q3.
2) GDPR/HIPAA: Confirmed — Arcadia will require a Data Processing Addendum; please include standard clauses and indicate whether Redwood uses subprocessors (list and regions).
3) DDQ: attaching our standard vendor DDQ (procurement-arcadia-ddq_v2.docx). Can you confirm whether you prefer us to upload this into a portal or if you'll complete and return? Procurement will coordinate.

Delivery method: TrustSafe portal is preferred for evidence. If you provide a temporary attestation while Type II is located that's helpful.

Can you copy your security contact on the completed DDQ and any attachments? 

Emily Carter
Director, Vendor Risk Management
Arcadia Health
emily.carter@arcadiahealth.com

(Procurement note: procurement@arcadiahealth.com is on the thread for contract/PO alignment)

Hi Emily / Arcadia Procurement — looping in our compliance team to start the handoff. Some immediate items we can provide today: 

- Temporary attestation: attached (redwood_temp_attestation_2026.pdf). This covers current control posture and lists subprocessors.
- TrustSafe portal invite: generated. Link below provides one-time access; portal contains our SOC 2 Type II (once located) and control maps.
  - TrustSafe invite: https://trustsafe.redwood-inference.com/invite/Arcadia-9f2b

If you prefer SFTP for a one-time transfer, we can provision an SFTP drop with PGP and a retention policy. Aditya (cc) will provide keys and SFTP instructions if chosen. A quick note on scope: our SOC 2 Type II covers infrastructure, serving runtime, and deployment orchestration for hosted and dedicated modes — we will mark HIPAA/GDPR-relevant controls in the portal (control IDs and evidence pointers).

Requested timeline
- We'll upload the temporary attestation now and aim to surface the Type II artefact or a bridge letter within 48 business hours (assuming no outstanding legal restrictions).

Next steps for you
1) Confirm preferred evidence transfer method (TrustSafe portal vs. SFTP).
2) If DDQ requires portal upload, indicate whether procurement wants us to populate answers (we can do so and mark items for legal review).

Attachments: redwood_temp_attestation_2026.pdf (attestation, 2 pages).

Thanks,

Laura — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attestation. Procurement confirms TrustSafe portal is preferred; we'll use the invite link to review materials. Two small asks before we mark the DDQ assignment: 

- Can you indicate which controls map to HIPAA’s technical safeguards in the portal (control IDs are fine)? That will speed our internal review.
- Please confirm whether Redwood has a standard DPA we can start from; if yes, upload to TrustSafe or send to procurement@arcadiahealth.com.

I'll schedule a short call for Monday morning to review the DDQ split (procurement vs. InfoSec) — Vivek, can you and Aditya attend so we can confirm the SFTP fallback settings if needed?

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this buttoned up.

Emily Carter
Director, Vendor Risk Management
Arcadia Health
